title: Polynomial oracle collapses to ordinary polynomial time
statement: Let $O$ be a language over $\\{0,1\\}$. If $O$ is decidable in polynomial time, then the class of languages decidable in polynomial time with oracle access to $O$ is exactly the ordinary polynomial-time class: $	ext{P}^O=	ext{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $O$ is a language over the Boolean alphabet
